title: feat(ticklab): lock-ticks stay 2 and do not shrink Stab
science: Lock-tick escape tried and failed at the off-axis star, not a probe cell: adding the lock-tick t(w) = min_i |w - s_i|_1 as local data alongside occupancy does NOT shrink the stabilizer at v=(-1,1,1) - all four occupied ticks equal 2, so |Stab(sigma,t)| = |Stab(sigma)| = 2 and the occupancy swapper survives; N_tick_ok=0 against N_pair_support=4 (support members listed as (+,0,+,-,0,-),(+,0,-,+,0,-),(-,0,+,-,0,+),(-,0,-,+,0,+)). The swapper forces a monochrome y axis while every pair member y-bicolours it.
